examples.title: Completed step
examples.description: Timeline row for a successful execution step.
examples.behavior: Show sequence, status and key timing in one scan line.
examples.qa: Step order and status can be read quickly.

examples.title: Failed step
examples.description: Timeline row highlights the failed step and detail.
examples.behavior: Use local failure emphasis so the user can inspect the exact failed step.
examples.qa: Details explain the failure, not only the status badge.

examples.title: Collapsed step
examples.description: Long timelines can hide detail while preserving sequence.
examples.behavior: Collapse only secondary detail, not status or sequence.
